Disaster Vermin — Cursed Technique Reversal

You have learned the reversal of your technique. Rather than consuming and multiplying, you suppress the biological instincts of others. As an action for 6 CE, you create a 15 ft aura centered on you for 1 minute. A creature that starts their turn within this aura must make a Constitution saving throw whenever they attempt to gain temporary hit points or regain hit points. On a failed save, their body rejects the effect and the action and cursed energy cost used to give the temporary hit points or hit points are wasted. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more has their body begin to shut down, giving them disadvantage on Constitution saves and wasting their bonus action and reaction until the end of their next turn.
